The '''InterClan Tournament''' was a event undertaken by [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] who had received nomination. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] did not nominate a single member of [[Thranta Clan/Legends|Thranta Clan]] for the tournament.
